note: Random skin's rule (LullWebamp.pickSkin in web/desktop/webamp-session.js; docs/context/skins.md#random-skin). A player of its own (native Classic) that picks for itself checks its copy against these same cases. Each case: the listener's own skins and favourites (md5s), the one in use (null: Webamp's base skin), what random() returns, and the md5 picked (null: there is no other skin).

cases.name: one of their own, never the one in use
random's top end stays in range
the one in use is out of the draw, not skipped after it
a single skin of their own, while another is in use
a single skin of their own, already in use: there is no other
none of their own: the favourites
none of their own, the only favourite in use: there is no other
